design_notes: Flexible tickets are for a mission at risk of being cancelled or amended (lines 704-706); nothing on file says so. Under (a), lines 689-691, economy including non-refundable tickets at the lowest available rate: Iberia 12:40 at EUR 159. The changeable fare is declined on (b)'s condition, so the reason is REFUNDABLE_FARE_NOT_ALLOWED.
